text:
Product sense isn’t just a buzzword; it’s a vital skill that can make or break product success. It’s about understanding which decisions will resonate with users, based on a blend of experience and experimentation. 

In my journey from PM to a leadership role, I realized how critical it is to not only gather data but to interpret it through the lens of human behavior. It’s one thing to have patterns in your back pocket; it’s another to apply them in real-time, especially in fast-paced environments. 

After all, a feature that looks good on paper can still fail if it doesn’t connect with users emotionally. 

As I dive deeper into AI and its implications for product management, I can’t help but think: how do we cultivate this product sense in our teams? How do we move from merely analyzing data to leveraging it for impactful, user-centered decisions? 

Reflect on the last product decision you made—what insights guided you, and how did you ensure they were aligned with your users’ needs?

diagram_spec.diagram_prompt: A flowchart illustrating the process of transforming data insights into user-centered product decisions.
